cross_domain_admitted.reason: General heterogeneous flow-weighted network motif method; method transfer, not direct transit prior.
Climate/resource-flow dimension reduction proposed as transferable method, not tested metro mechanism.
Generic neutrosophic graph connectivity with some transportation examples; insufficient evidence for close metro capacity/cascade prior.

conclusions: Current R6.5 domain screen retains both resolved directly related papers and domain-context reviews.
It also admits 3 of 5 method-transfer candidates as domain candidates; same-domain candidate precision is low in this selected silver set.
Unavailable OpenAlex abstract for 1 truly related article prevents complete-source inference; not a wrong DOI or evidence of research absence.
Automated downstream nearest-prior semantic validation and true cross-paper scientific value are untested.
The silver benchmark is small and one-reviewer-labeled, cannot establish broad accuracy or causal gains over the prior version.

Four bounded live PR/push runs executed due initial workflow trigger configuration, all returned the same incomplete coverage and candidate decisions; triggers were narrowed to avoid repeated PR-update queries.
next_decisions: Do not retune and rescore this same silver set as a fresh held-out test.
Get independent reviewer for gold labels, particularly 3 cross-domain borderline papers.
Use a separate development set to implement and test a method-transfer candidate lane; reserve another unseen test set.
Do not run new DeepSeek A/B before explicitly authorized for independent source.
